en: Dependent on a state that is with-conflict (*saraṇa*) and has a past object, a state that is without-conflict (*na-saraṇa*) and does not have a past object arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is without-conflict (*araṇa*) and has a past object, a state that is without-conflict and does not have a past object arises by way of root condition.
[Under] root [condition], there are two; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance [condition], there are two.

Dependent on a state that is with-conflict (*saraṇa*) and has a future object, there arises a state that is without-conflict (*na-saraṇa*) and does not have a future object, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is without-conflict (*araṇa*) and has a future object, there arises a state that is without-conflict and does not have a future object, by way of root condition.
[Under] root condition there are two; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance condition there are two.

Dependent on a state that is with-conflict (*saraṇa*) and has a present object, there arises a state that is without-conflict (*na-saraṇa*) and does not have a present object, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is without-conflict (*araṇa*) and has a present object, there arises a state that is without-conflict and does not have a present object, by way of root condition.
[Under] root [condition] there are two; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance [condition] there are two.
